we have designed, implemented, and evaluated an architecture that provides disciplined support for approximate computing, that we have designed and evaluated a disciplined approximate programming language, and that we have demonstrated a 2X-5X speedup in performance with no loss of correctness for a range of applications.

the design of hardware and software that enables approximate computation in a disciplined manner.
the design, implementation and analysis of a disciplined approximate programming language and its compiler and runtime system.
